collection.description: A villager assumes a visitor is related to another person because they share a similar appearance.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (villager) assumes (visitor), a visitor, is related to another person because they share a similar appearance.

choices.label: Apologize and Ask About Their Actual Connection
Invite the Visitors to Introduce Themselves
Move on Without Making a Spectacle

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The visitors explain they have only just met.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They turn out to be cousins but dislike the assumption nonetheless.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (villager) recognizes how easily appearance becomes an unreliable story.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They realize they would not have made the same guess about familiar neighbors.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Each shares something distinctive about their interests.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: One chooses to say very little, and that is respected.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (villager) later offers a quiet apology rather than seeking public praise.

d1__fx.name: Outcome D1
d1__fx.text: The awkwardness fades during a shared meal.
